intro: Ursal the Mauler is the culmination of Athridas Bearmantle's efforts to awaken the slumbering Druids of the Talon in Teldrassil. To break the unnatural sleep binding his brethren within the Barrow Den, the corrupted furbolg chief responsible for disrupting their calling must be slain.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Now the time has come to save the Druids of the Talon. If we fail now, friend, they will be forever lost in sleep.

I shall prepare the Relics of Wakening and perform the ritual. For my work to take effect, the cursed beast responsible for this horrible situation must be slain. Only then will the ritual be complete.
It was Ursal the Mauler who meddled with our brethren's calling and it is Ursal the Mauler who must now pay so they can be freed. Travel to Gnarlpine Hold in the southwest and slay him.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Our brethren cannot be awakened until Ursal the Mauler has been slain, friend.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Friend you have proven yourself a most worthy and able adventurer. A traveler who follows the path of honor as sure as you do is certain to find great glory in this world.
May the forest spirits protect you wherever your travels may take you.
